title: orania longisquama
intro: Orania longisquama, commonly known as the African Baobab, is a deciduous tree native to tropical Africa. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its high fiber content and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the Orania longisquama include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, diarrhea, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
